2.14.20
Rectangle.PageBreak
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Rectangle.PageBreak element specifies page break properties for a Rectangle. This element is
optional and is of type PageBreak.
Following is the parent element of the Rectangle.PageBreak element.
Parent elements
Rectangle
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Rectangle.PageBreak element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreak" type="PageBreakType" minOccurs="0" />
